heavy_hit-red-1.text: Red puts some weight behind that one.
heavy_hit-red-1.speaker: b

pressure_run-red-1.text: Red is keeping the pressure on.
pressure_run-red-1.speaker: b

counter_swing-red-0.text: Red answers with two of their own!
counter_swing-red-0.speaker: b

hazard_impact-red-0.text: Red gets caught by the train!
hazard_impact-red-0.speaker: a

ring_out-red-0.text: Red wins! The other team goes over the edge!
ring_out-red-0.speaker: a

train_finish-red-0.text: Red wins after that train collision!
train_finish-red-0.speaker: a

train_finish-red-1.text: Red takes it. The train had the final word.
train_finish-red-1.speaker: b

heavy_hit-blue-1.text: Blue puts some weight behind that one.
heavy_hit-blue-1.speaker: b

pressure_run-blue-1.text: Blue is keeping the pressure on.
pressure_run-blue-1.speaker: b

counter_swing-blue-0.text: Blue answers with two of their own!
counter_swing-blue-0.speaker: b

hazard_impact-blue-0.text: Blue gets caught by the train!
hazard_impact-blue-0.speaker: a

ring_out-blue-0.text: Blue wins! The other team goes over the edge!
ring_out-blue-0.speaker: a

train_finish-blue-0.text: Blue wins after that train collision!
train_finish-blue-0.speaker: a

train_finish-blue-1.text: Blue takes it. The train had the final word.
train_finish-blue-1.speaker: b

round_start-any-0.text: Two bodies, four operators. Let the brawl begin!
round_start-any-0.speaker: a

round_start-any-1.text: Arms and legs, please coordinate your opening statement.
round_start-any-1.speaker: b

trade-any-1.text: An exchange of strongly held opinions.
trade-any-1.speaker: b

double_fall-any-0.text: Both go over! This round is a draw!
double_fall-any-0.speaker: a

double_fall-any-1.text: A draw. Equal commitment to the wrong direction.
double_fall-any-1.speaker: b

quiet_brawl-any-0.text: Four people. Two bodies. No motion carried.
quiet_brawl-any-0.speaker: b

quiet_brawl-any-1.text: I once waited this long for an opening. Worth every second.
quiet_brawl-any-1.speaker: a

quiet_brawl-any-2.text: The legs and arms are still in negotiations.
quiet_brawl-any-2.speaker: b

round_start-any-ice-1.text: On this ice, every shove comes with free delivery to the edge.
round_start-any-ice-1.speaker: b

round_start-any-classic-1.text: No traps, no excuses. Just four people trying to agree on a direction.
round_start-any-classic-1.speaker: b

round_start-any-skyline-1.text: Tonight we settle this above the city. Please keep all grudges away from the open edges.
round_start-any-skyline-1.speaker: b

round_start-any-quake-1.text: A fractured summit, four operators. Watch the tremors before the mountain pulls apart.
round_start-any-quake-1.speaker: b

round_start-any-mountain-1.text: Welcome to Cloudpeak. Training obstacles, mountain air, and absolutely no safety net.
round_start-any-mountain-1.speaker: b

round_start-any-station-1.text: Terraces, a transfer bridge, and two very active tracks. Mind the gap and your opponent.
round_start-any-station-1.speaker: b

round_start-any-twinspire-1.text: Opposite towers tonight. Cross the bridge before you try to cross your opponent.
round_start-any-twinspire-1.speaker: b

round_start-any-piano-1.text: A concert grand becomes a fight club. Watch the sharps and the edge of the case.
round_start-any-piano-1.speaker: b

round_start-any-archery-1.text: The archers are aiming from above. Your opponent is only half the problem.
round_start-any-archery-1.speaker: b

round_start-any-sumo-1.text: Open sumo stage, incoming lasers. This tournament has unusual referees.
round_start-any-sumo-1.speaker: b

round_start-any-tiles-1.text: The tiles come back. Your chance to stand on them may not.
round_start-any-tiles-1.speaker: b

round_start-any-split-1.text: Two halves of a floor, two halves of a brain per fighter. This should go beautifully.
round_start-any-split-1.speaker: b

round_start-any-platforms-1.text: Tonight even the ground has somewhere else to be. Stay aboard.
round_start-any-platforms-1.speaker: b

round_start-any-lava-1.text: Tonight the floor really is lava. Childhood prepared nobody for the uppercuts.
round_start-any-lava-1.speaker: b

round_start-any-falling-1.text: Every step spends a little floor. Make this round count before the arena runs out.
round_start-any-falling-1.speaker: b

round_start-any-conveyor-1.text: Welcome to the factory. Please keep hands, feet, and unresolved grudges off the conveyor.
round_start-any-conveyor-1.speaker: b
